title_sq: Shitet apartament i tipologjise 2+1+2 me post parkimi ne Ali Dem!
description_sq:
Shitet apartament i tipologjise 2+1+2 me post parkimi ne kompleksin “Darling”, i cili ndodhet ne rrugen Ali Demi. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 7-te dhe organizimi tij eshte si me poshte: hyrja me korridor, salloni i ndenjes i lidhur me kendin e gatimit dhe me dalje ne ballkon, dy dhima gjumi dhe dy tualete. Pallati ne te cilin ndodhet apartamenti lokalizohet ne nje zone lehtesisht te aksesueshme prane Unazes se Madhe. Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor dhe shitet i mobiluar. Zona ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode.
Ne cmim perfshihet dhe nje post parkimi. Per me shume informacion dhe vizite ne prone kontaktoni IRG131988
title_en: 2+1+2 typology apartment for sale with parking post in Ali Dem!
description_en: 2+1+2 typology apartment for sale with parking in the "Darling" complex, which is located on Ali Demi street. The apartment is located on the 7th floor and its organization is as follows: entrance with corridor, living room connected to the kitchen corner and exit to the balcony, two bedrooms and two toilets. The building in which the apartment is located is located in an easily accessible area near the Great Ring Road. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation and is sold furnished. The area offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life. The price includes a parking post. For more information and a visit to the property, contact IRG131988
